messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- On 2025-10-22, Team Dune decided that the webhooks service will sign payloads with rotating keys. [decision; valid 2025-10-22 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-10-22]
- Team Dune decided the webhooks service will sign payloads with rotating keys because a partner asked for key rotation in their security review. [valid 2025-10-22 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-10-22]
- As of 2025-06-20, the webhooks service lives with Team Dune, which took it over from Team Atlas. [valid 2025-07-04 to now; recorded by handover/2025-07-04-webhooks-correction]
    earlier: As of 2025-06-20, the webhooks service lives with the Ember team, which took it over from Team Atlas. [valid 2025-06-20 to 2025-07-04; recorded by handover/2025-06-20-webhooks]
    earlier: As of 2025-03-28, the webhooks service lives with Team Atlas. [valid 2025-03-28 to 2025-06-20; recorded by handover/2025-03-28-webhooks]
    earlier: The webhooks service lives with Team Boreal. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-03-28; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-09-2]
- INC-2026-003 was an incident in which the webhooks service delivered some events twice on 2026-01-17. [valid 2026-01-22 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-003]
- The webhooks service only ships on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-03-17 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-03-17]
- On 2025-08-01, it was decided that certificate expiry will alert 30 days ahead. [decision; valid 2025-08-01 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-017]
- The root cause of INC-2026-003 was a retry loop that ignored idempotency keys. [valid 2026-01-22 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-003]
- On 2026-01-22, the team decided the webhooks service will require an idempotency key on every delivery, because the duplicate deliveries in INC-2026-003 came from retries without one. [decision; valid 2026-01-22 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-003]
- Changes to the auth gateway require two reviewer approvals and a security sign-off. [constraint; valid 2025-08-14 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-08-14]
- On 2025-05-23, the Ember team flagged that the webhooks service's request volume halved following the client rollout. [valid 2025-06-20 to now; recorded by handover/2025-06-20-webhooks]
    earlier: On 2025-05-23, the Ember team flagged that the webhooks service's request volume halved following the client rollout, noting the webhooks service is not their service. [valid 2025-05-23 to 2025-06-20; recorded by standup/ember/2025-05-23]
- As of 2025-11-13, the ledger is owned by the Ember team, which took it over from Team Atlas. [valid 2025-11-13 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-13-ledger]
    earlier: The ledger lives with Team Atlas. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-11-13; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08]
- The Ember team never owned the webhooks service. [valid 2025-07-04 to now; recorded by handover/2025-07-04-webhooks-correction]
- The notifier will retry failed pushes three times with exponential backoff. [decision; valid 2025-02-20 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-02-20]
- On 2026-05-25, Team Atlas reported that the webhooks service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change. [valid 2026-05-25 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-05-25-2]
- As of 2026-03-04, the webhooks service remains a Team Dune service. [valid 2026-03-04 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-03-04]
- On 2026-01-22, Team Atlas decided that auth gateway tokens will expire after 15 minutes instead of an hour. [decision; valid 2026-01-22 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-01-22]
- Ledger migrations will ship with a reviewed query plan. [decision; valid 2025-04-28 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-011]
- The webhooks service depends on the event bus for outbound events. [valid 2025-01-17 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-17]
- As of 2025-12-23, the auth gateway is owned by Team Atlas, which took it over from Team Boreal. [valid 2025-12-23 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-23-auth-gateway]
    earlier: As of 2025-03-31, the auth gateway is a Team Boreal service. [valid 2025-03-31 to 2025-12-23; recorded by handover/2025-03-31-auth-gateway]
    earlier: The auth gateway is an Ember team service. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-03-31; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-20-2]
- On 2026-03-31, the Ember team observed that the feature-flags service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and flagged it because the service is not theirs. [valid 2026-03-31 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-03-31]
